title: Add rule prohibiting aliases for new models
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Require new models, including new versions and checkpoints, to have no aliases.
- Preserve existing alias targets until removal and retire legacy aliases through explicit migrations.
- Replace the previous alias rule in model-management; keep the policy in one place.

Validation: skill validator and `git diff --check` pass.

gist.headline: No More Model Nicknames
gist.blurb: The model garden has a clearer labeling rule: new arrivals get one proper name. Existing signposts stay put until a deliberate migration moves them.
gist.summary: Updated the model-management policy so new models, versions, and checkpoints ship without aliases, while existing alias targets remain until explicitly migrated or removed.
gist.impact: Model maintainers get a single documented rule for naming new model entries and can retire legacy aliases through deliberate migrations.
gist.visual_concept: Polli, wearing tiny librarian glasses, organizes a cozy garden shelf of clearly labeled model seed packets while older packets keep their familiar signposts until a careful transplant. A small retro terminal and code-vines represent the centralized model-management policy.
